Hi Asha —

Sorry we missed each other for the scheduled demo earlier today. I realize things move fast when execs are traveling. To keep momentum without rebooking a full cross-functional meeting right away, two quick options that have worked well for other pilot customers: 

1) Async option — we’ll record a 12–15 minute walkthrough of the key workflows + short architecture notes. You can share with the execs and we’ll follow up with a 30-minute technical Q&A when they’re available.

2) Split live option — two focused 30-minute slots next week: one technical deep-dive (engineers), one executive overview (product/ops). Keeps sessions tight and stakeholder-focused.

If either helps, please tell me preferred days/times (we’re in PDT). I’ve attached a short deck + a Doodle poll if you want to propose windows: https://doodle.com/poll/noventa-redwood-pilot.

Attachments: redwood-overview-deck.pdf (slide summary)

Would you like me to send the recording by end of week if you think exec availability will be delayed?

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher

- Send a concise 12–15m recording and attach pilot-architecture-notes.pdf today (low friction).
- Offer two 30-minute live slots for engineering next Tue/Wed morning PT (propose 09:30–10:00 and 10:30–11:00 PT).
- For execs, prep an 18-slide exec deck and reserve Oct 4/5/6 windows but only schedule once they confirm via Doodle — this avoids calendar churn.

Action items:
- Marissa: can you produce the quick recording (screen + voice) and the short architecture notes? 20–30 minutes to record is fine.
- Soojin: I’ll need the two recommended technical leads to join the 30-min slot; please be on standby for tech questions and to own the Q&A.
- I’ll send the external email with links and attach the deck + the poll.

Also thinking about a low-friction concession: offer a 14-day pilot credit if they sign an SOW by the end of Oct — useful to mention in exec thread if they ask for timelines. Thoughts?

Thanks — will draft the outbound after the recording is ready.

Sean
